description: Schema for the V0 static governed authority registry — the source of truth for actor execution eligibility and observation authority grants

structure.description: Top-level object keyed by actor FQDN

execution_authority.description: Execution eligibility declarations for this actor

allowed_workflows.description: Explicit list of workflow FQDNs the actor is authorized to invoke; wildcards are forbidden

observation_authority.description: Observation eligibility declarations: what this actor may observe; defaults to no observation rights if absent

visibility_scope.description: Projection visibility constraints for this actor

trace_scope.description: Trace visibility constraints for this actor

constraints: Actor keys MUST use FQDN format
Workflow values MUST use FQDN format
Wildcard grants are a constitutional violation — authority not explicitly granted is denied
Compiler validates: actor references exist, workflow references exist, schema correctness
Runtime reads resolved authority state only — never mutates this registry
Observation authority is separate from execution authority — one may be granted without the other
